definitions.gloss: corruption; graft; bribery in public office
definitions.explanation: Dishonest or illegal conduct by government officials or public servants, especially involving bribery or abuse of power for personal gain.

examples.japanese: {汚職|おしょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{汚職|おしょく}スキャンダル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mayor's corruption scandal was reported in the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{汚職|おしょく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{制定|せいてい}→制定：11907_seitei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government enacted a new law to prevent corruption.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {汚|お} (dirty, corrupt) and ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧ (position, office). Specifically refers to corruption in public office — misuse of governmental authority for personal gain. For corporate corruption, ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧ is more commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚職|おしょく}スキャンダル (corruption scandal)
- {汚職|おしょく}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧ (corruption case)
- {汚職|おしょく}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (corruption prevention)
- {汚職|おしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}を{染|そ}める→手を染める：07451_tewosomeru⟧ (to get involved in corruption)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賄賂|わいろ}→賄賂：21571_wairo⟧: bribery — the act of giving or receiving bribes, a specific form of {汚職|おしょく}
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧: fraud, irregularity — broader term covering dishonest acts in any context
